CustomField.description: Enable this setting for Groove to create a Notes record for each user writing into the Omnibar Notes tab, as opposed to storing their notes in a field on the respective objects. Before enabling this, ensure you have Notes enabled in Salesforce - if not, Groove will fall back to storing the notes in a text field
